name: Open, unbound
description: The PR exists and no environment holds its build. Initial state. Nothing in the estate refers to it.

name: Requested
description: change:requested. A person has asked for the change to begin. No claim on any tier.

name: Release armed
description: The bare `release` label is on. A standing human trigger the scheduler consumes; left on it re-fires.

name: Emergency declared (itil:emergency)
description: A person declared THIS change the remedy. It may reach production without the berth. Distinct from the estate `emergency` label, which is on issue #1 and exempts nobody.

name: Served on a dev block
description: A build of this PR answers on 9000+10n, n<=9. Disposable tier; promotes=no. The only record is a ports.tsv row.

name: Dev block held, nothing listening
description: UNNAMED. ports.tsv claims the block, no process answers. The registry allocates by editing a file and never asks the socket table.

name: Held in a team environment
description: 9100-9199. Real, leased, reachable -- and CANNOT promote, because no team: observation namespace exists for guard 4 to read.

name: Declared, not activated
description: ESTATE property of a named environment. The row exists and owns its ports so nothing else takes them; nothing is expected to answer. deploy.sh refuses with exit 6.

name: Scheduled, unberthed
description: change:scheduled. A window is booked. Berth position 1: a record, and nothing blocks on it.

name: Berthed
description: deploy:staging held. The singleton path to production (:9200) is this change's. Berth position 2.

name: Staging serving this head
description: The staging front at :9200 answers with x-build-sha equal to the PR head. The environment and the change agree.

name: Staging verified
description: staging:e2e, staging:smoke and staging:uat recorded against this head on :9200. Berth position 3 -- verified is not safe.

name: Cleared for production
description: deploy:production held. Berth position 4. Everything about it was established against a main that may since have moved.

name: Idle colour loaded
description: UNNAMED. The build is installed and answering on the idle replica (:9210 or :9220). The front at :9230 does not route to it. Reachable from the LAN, serving nobody.

name: Live
description: targets/node/live names this colour, so :9230 proxies this build. The only moment that changes what strangers see.

name: Production converged
description: production:healthy. N samples at the production address, every one on this build, exactly one distinct build seen. Convergence, not liveness.

name: Merged
description: The change is on trunk. The forge's MERGED is now the record.

name: Complete
description: change:complete. Terminal for VALIDATION: nothing remains to observe. The labels are about to be cleared.

name: Settled and cleaned
description: Transient labels cleared. What survives is the PIR comment, the deployment record and the PR timeline. TERMINAL.

name: Landed, record owed
description: change:backfill-owed. The change reached main without the normal evidence and owes the window, the observations and the reason. Blocks nothing; only a person may clear it.

name: Blocked on the berth
description: blocked:queue. Another open PR holds deploy:staging. Guard 1 -- the label is the lock, not the concurrency group.

name: Blocked by the estate
description: blocked:freeze. A freeze or an estate emergency covers the window. The PR-side shadow of an estate fact it does not own.

name: Blocked by the lock
description: blocked:lock. The deployment lock names another run, less than 60 minutes old.

name: Blocked, diverged
description: blocked:diverged. main moved under this change by an artifact or hotfix merge; its staging pass describes a tree that no longer composes.

name: Closed, failed
description: change:failed. ITIL closure code. Production never served this build, or never had it made live. Nothing to undo. TERMINAL.

name: Closed, backed out
description: change:backed-out. Production DID serve it and the estate was returned to a prior state. Asserts an estate action and must name what it returned to. TERMINAL.

name: Window expired, unscheduled
description: The reservation lapsed unattempted. Its own closure code -- not failed, not cancelled. The change keeps everything else and is left with NO lifecycle label, which is the honest state.

name: Berth held, window gone, serving nowhere
description: UNNAMED. deploy:staging is on the PR, no window is open, and :9200 serves something else or nothing. Guard 1 blocks every other change with no declared cause. Found live on #92.

name: Idle colour retains an unshipped build
description: UNNAMED, ESTATE-GLOBAL residue attributable to a PR. A build reachable at :9210/:9220 that production never served. Cleared by NOTHING -- only the next deploy to that colour overwrites it.

name: Attested healthy for a build it is not serving
description: UNNAMED. A verdict names a build the environment is not running: a two-request check across a mixed fleet, a switch that read its own config file, or a deploy that reported success and then died with its parent shell.

name: Deployed, not merged
description: Production serves a build trunk does not contain. Named in the boundary conditions; the correct handling is that the next change branches from a trunk without it and reverts it.

name: Deployed, not merged, and the window is gone
description: UNNAMED -- the spec's own `one that has no name yet`. Three facts at once and no vocabulary for them. Reached twice here, once by a script that reported the opposite.

name: Environment unreachable -- INDETERMINATE
description: The instrument could not reach the address. A THIRD VALUE: not a pass and not a failure. It blocks, it never exempts, and no edge leaves it for a pass without a successful measurement.

name: Up, correct, and unreachable by construction
description: The process is healthy but bound to 127.0.0.1, or in a block outside pf's pass range. The tier says protected; the audience says nobody. From the instrument's host it is indistinguishable from nothing listening.

name: Estate frozen
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. `freeze` on issue #1. Ordinary change is suspended for everyone including the declarer. A property of the world, never of a change.

name: Estate emergency in flight
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. `emergency` on issue #1. Standard and normal changes stop; it grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it.

name: Frozen, with no declarer
description: UNNAMED, ESTATE-GLOBAL. The estate is stopped and the record names neither actor nor reason. An authorised halt and a hostile one leave byte-identical records.

name: Control plane beyond the boundary
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. The unauthenticated freeze/emergency/schedule-clear POSTs are reachable from outside the LAN. Changes who may move every PR; changes no environment's tier, port or guard.
